sents.t: General Shim is resting on his rooftop when he sees something that leaves him terrified.
sents.zh: General Shim 正在自家屋顶上休息，这时他看到了一样让他吓坏了的东西。

sents.t: General Shim writes, "I just wanted to loiter on my house's rooftop because the breeze there is soothing and fresh, but little did I know that someone else would be there with me."
sents.zh: General Shim 写道：“我只是想在屋顶上待一会儿，因为那里的风清新又舒服，没想到还有‘别人’和我在一起。”

sents.t: General Shim hopes that this was just a coconut on a tree, but what do you see?
sents.zh: General Shim 希望那只是树上的一个椰子，但你看到的是什么？

sents.t: Could this be a case of pareidolia, or an actual sinister-looking entity?
sents.zh: 这是“空想性错视”（把东西看成人脸），还是真有一个阴森的东西？
